emsStrategies.label: Peak Shaving
emsStrategies.explanation: Discharge BESS when site demand exceeds the contracted or economic threshold.

emsStrategies.label: TOU Optimization
emsStrategies.explanation: Charge during low-cost windows and discharge during expensive windows while preserving reserve.

emsStrategies.label: PV Self-Consumption
emsStrategies.explanation: Route PV to load first, charge BESS from surplus, and avoid unauthorized export.

emsStrategies.label: Critical Load Backup
emsStrategies.explanation: Maintain energy reserve and transfer critical loads to ESS/generator path during grid events.

emsStrategies.label: Power Quality Support
emsStrategies.explanation: Use PCS capabilities for reactive support, harmonic governance, and phase balancing when validated.

powerFlowPriority: PV surplus -> BESS when SOC ceiling allows
BESS -> critical load during peak, outage, or TOU strategy
Grid -> load and BESS only when EMS economics or reserve require it
Generator -> critical load and/or BESS only under approved fallback sequence

commissioningGates.label: HVDC insulation resistance test
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Megger/IR report across HVDC bus, cabinet, and earth before energization.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Undetected insulation fault can create arc, shock, or PCS trip during precharge.

commissioningGates.label: PCS precharge validation
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Logged DC bus ramp, contactor sequence, and no inrush alarm.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Inrush transient can damage DC link capacitors or trip protection.

commissioningGates.label: AC phase sequence and voltage check
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: L1/L2/L3 sequence, 400 VAC reference, neutral/earth verification.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Reverse phase or neutral fault can break STS synchronization and motor loads.

commissioningGates.label: Meter and CT polarity
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Import/export direction verified on Eastron/anti-reverse meter under load.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: EMS may export power when it intends to import, violating utility constraint.

commissioningGates.label: BMS CAN communication
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: BMS heartbeat, SOC, alarms, charge/discharge limits visible in PCS/EMS.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: PCS may operate without valid battery limits, causing trips or unsafe dispatch.

commissioningGates.label: STS synchronization and transfer
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Grid-loss transfer test with voltage, frequency, phase-angle, and transfer time log.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Critical load may reboot or breaker may trip during unsynchronized transfer.

commissioningGates.label: EMS strategy acceptance test
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Peak shaving, TOU, PV surplus charge, anti-export, backup reserve test cases.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: System may be technically installed but fail the business objective.

commissioningGates.label: Fire and gas detection chain
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Smoke, gas, thermal alarm, suppression, E-stop, and signage verification.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Thermal event may not be detected or contained early.

commissioningGates.label: Utility export limit compliance
commissioningGates.evidenceRequired: Documented export permission or zero-export commissioning report.
commissioningGates.riskIfSkipped: Unauthorized export can violate interconnection rules.

failureModes.label: CT polarity reversed
failureModes.detection: Import/export readings move opposite to actual load step.
failureModes.mitigation: Correct CT orientation, phase mapping, and meter sign convention before enabling anti-export.

failureModes.label: BMS/PCS protocol mismatch
failureModes.detection: PCS cannot read SOC, alarms, charge limit, or discharge limit over CAN.
failureModes.mitigation: Select exact protocol profile and firmware pair; verify heartbeat and limits under commissioning mode.

failureModes.label: STS unsynchronized transfer
failureModes.detection: Transfer event creates voltage transient, breaker trip, or load reboot.
failureModes.mitigation: Validate phase angle, frequency, voltage matching, SYNC1/SYNC2, and carrier synchronization.

failureModes.label: EMS reserve misconfigured
failureModes.detection: BESS reaches low SOC before outage or peak window ends.
failureModes.mitigation: Lock minimum backup SOC by load class and require approval before lowering reserve.

failureModes.label: Liquid cooling loop fault
failureModes.detection: Cell delta-T, coolant alarm, pump alarm, or cabinet thermal derating.
failureModes.mitigation: Verify coolant concentration, pump operation, leak checks, and temperature sensor mapping.

assumptions: Commercial BESS data is seeded from operator-provided project brief and must be attached to OEM documentation before EPC release.
Usable energy uses a configurable DoD assumption; warranty-specific usable energy must be confirmed.
STS transfer time target does not guarantee load continuity until tested with real critical loads.
Grid code, fire code, and utility interconnection requirements must be signed off by qualified local engineers.
